# Login to Spotify once
spotify_creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_password = next(c['password'] for c in spotify_creds if c['account_name']=='spotify')
spotify_username = 'ca-smit@gmail.com'
spotify_token_resp = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username, password=spotify_password)
print(spotify_token_resp)
spotify_token = spotify_token_resp['access_token']

# Fetch song queue
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=spotify_token)
print('queue_count', len(queue))
# Identify current song position
current_positions = [s for s in queue if s.get('is_current')]
print('current_songs', current_positions)
current_position = current_positions[0]['position'] if current_positions else None
print('current_position', current_position)

# Determine songs played so far (including current) by position boundary
songs_to_like = [s for s in queue if s['position'] <= current_position]
print('songs_to_like_count', len(songs_to_like))
print('songs_to_like_ids', [s['song_id'] for s in songs_to_like])

# Like each song
results = []
for s in songs_to_like:
    res = apis.spotify.like_song(song_id=s['song_id'], access_token=spotify_token)
    results.append((s['song_id'], res))
print('like_results', results)

missing = [s['song_id'] for s in songs_to_like if s['song_id'] not in liked_ids]
print('missing', missing)
